label: Absolute positional embedding
hint: Learned [max_seq, dim] bias added along the sequence axis after token embeddings (same last dim).

hint: Capture layer activations from the MLP for tensor analysis.

hint: Adam optimizer for training the connected MLP.

label: AdamW

hint: AFNO atomic layer: one AFNO-lite encoder-style block (spectral + feedforward residuals).

hint: AFNO-lite composite model: patchify + low-frequency spectral mixer + feedforward blocks over spatiotemporal tokens, then decode back to flat fields.

hint: AFNO atomic layer: lightweight spatial decode/refinement on flattened field tensors.

hint: AFNO atomic layer: patch embed and decode in flat field space. Use in input-output mode for custom AFNO chains.

hint: AFNO atomic layer: low-frequency spectral mixing on flattened spatiotemporal fields.

hint: Multi-head self-attention on [batch, T, d] (causal or bidirectional); no embed/LM head.

label: Basic calculator
hint: Combine N scalar tensors with a LaTeX formula (x_1, x_2, …) into one scalar output tensor.

hint: Bigram dataset with low-rank transition logits; sample x from stationary distribution then y from P(y|x).

hint: Synthetic biography / fact-sheet token LM with template vs shuffle vs noisy slots (Physics-of-LLM-style probe).

hint: Bigram random walk on a circular vocabulary: from each token, move left/right with configurable bias.

hint: Synthetic COGS-flavored seq2seq pairs (not the full EMNLP corpus).

label: Combined model
hint: Saved combined subgraph from the library (same as Model list): expandable shell with inner layers.

label: Comment
hint: Sticky note on the canvas.

label: CRL environment (U4 maze / point)
hint: CRL navigation env preset (point U4 maze or Ant U4–style sizing; server-side sim).

hint: Deep residual MLP for CRL actor and φ/ψ encoders (four Dense+LN+Swish stages per block).

hint: Contrastive RL (PyTorch): env, CRL residual MLP, optimizer, replay + InfoNCE + actor.

label: Cross-entropy
hint: Cross-entropy for classification (e.g. token prediction).

label: Curve annotator
hint: Attach to Training or Observable viz; mirror plot and label x-ranges (plateau, spike, …).

label: Cyclic batch schedule
hint: Cyclic batch size (Jastrzębski Fig 1 left CBS). Wire to trainer **batch schedule** socket.

label: Cyclic LR schedule
hint: Cyclic learning rate (Jastrzębski Fig 1 left CLR). Wire to optimizer **lr schedule** socket.

label: Derivative curve
hint: Compute 1st–5th finite-difference derivative on a rank-1 (1D) tensor, preview it, and pass it downstream as tensor.

label: Deterministic diffusion sampler
hint: DDIM-like sampler with a fixed seed; generated images persist as runtime data.

label: Diagonal SSM (tokens)
hint: Diagonal input-dependent SSM recurrence stacked with residuals; token LM.

label: Diffusion MSE loss
hint: Loss socket for diffusion_score_model training (noise MSE inside trainer loop).

label: Diffusion PDE field (2D)
hint: Synthetic 2D heat-equation fields: flattened space-time windows for MSE regression / MPP-style ViT.

label: Diffusion score MLP
hint: MLP εθ(x_t, t) for DDPM-style noise prediction on vectors; use with diffusion_mse_loss + vector datasets.

label: Dimension permutator
hint: Reorder tensor dimensions by wiring in↔out dots (row-major); left and right sockets are both labeled tensor.

label: Dyck language dataset
hint: Balanced bracket strings as token ids (Dyck-style); cross-entropy LM probe.

label: Effective rank
hint: Scalar effective rank (entropy over singular values) of an upstream matrix tensor.

label: Einsum
hint: Einstein summation / einsum equation on the tensor chain.

fields.label: Equation
fields.defaultValue: b h t d, b h s d -> b h t s

label: Elementwise transform
hint: Apply a scalar rule f(x) to each tensor element (LaTeX-style rule, default x^2).

label: Embedding layer
hint: torch.nn.Embedding: left tensor = index map (long at runtime; float batches are cast), right tensor = float vectors.

label: Fake tensor (shape check)
hint: Declare a shape/dtype and run Check to annotate tensor sizes on wires or mark nodes where static shape rules disagree.

label: Flatten
hint: Collapse tensor axes: optional dimension index to keep separate; empty/null flattens to a single axis (shape check).

label: Formal language suite dataset
hint: Generators for a^n b^n, palindrome, parity, etc.; controlled formal languages.

label: Gated MLP
hint: MLP with multiplicative gating per hidden block: act(Wg x) * (Wv x).

label: Gaussian blob
hint: Synthetic toy: K class-specific 2D Gaussian blobs on a grid (K configurable), plus configurable per-image noise (no download).

label: Hole counting (synthetic blobs)
hint: Synthetic blob with k circular holes; classify k (0..max holes).

label: Hyena-like conv (tokens)
hint: Causal depthwise conv + gated FFN blocks; convolutional sequence LM.

label: IDNNs initialization
hint: Re-initialize every Linear layer with the released IDNNs convention: fan-in truncated-normal weights (two standard deviations) and zero biases.

label: Image dataset displayer
hint: Preview vision dataset rows (MNIST, Gaussian blob, shape world, hole counting): wire dataset → train/test split, index range, grid columns.

label: In-context associative recall dataset
hint: Associative recall sequences: key-value pairs plus a query key; target is the mapped value token.

label: Information bottleneck input table
hint: Deterministically samples the locally bundled binary F/y table. The asset is SHA-256 verified at runtime; its external provenance and licence are unverified.

label: Input sampler
hint: Samples N inputs from a wired random-input distribution and emits a sample tensor.

label: KAN (pykan)
hint: Kolmogorov–Arnold network (pykan KAN) for regression with the MSE trainer.

label: KAN reg
hint: pykan get_reg() regularization (λ and inner lamb_* coeffs) added to MSE for kan_model only; connect to Trainer observables.

observable.infoMarkdown: **KAN reg** — adds pykan-style regularization terms (L1 on activations, entropy, coefficient sparsity, etc.) scaled by the λ fields. Logged as a scalar when used as a loss-side observable.

label: Keskar C1/C2 CNN
hint: Keskar C1/C2 CNN for 32×32 CIFAR-10; batch-size sharpness repro.

label: L1 Reg
hint: L1 weight regularization (loss scale × Σ|w|) added to the primary loss; wire to Trainer loss together with MSE or cross-entropy.

label: L2 Projection
hint: After each optimizer step, project trainable weights onto an L2 norm shell; wire to Trainer loss socket (does not add to loss).

label: L2 Reg
hint: L2 weight regularization (loss scale × Σw²) added to the primary loss; wire to Trainer loss together with MSE or cross-entropy.

label: LayerNorm layer
hint: torch.nn.LayerNorm over the trailing normalized_shape dimensions.

label: Linear attention (tokens)
hint: ELU+1 causal linear attention LM bundle (optional DW conv mixing); last-token CE.

label: Linear Dataset
hint: Synthetic linear regression dataset feeding the MLP trainer.

label: Linear layer
hint: torch.nn.Linear as a chainable layer; left tensor ← upstream, right tensor → next layer or trainer model socket.

label: ListOps toy dataset
hint: Toy [ MIN a b ] integer expressions; scalar target token.

label: Local mixing layer (Canon-lite)
hint: Causal depthwise conv + residual along sequence (Canon-lite); same last dim as upstream [..., T, C].

label: LR schedule
hint: Warmup steps, constant vs cosine decay, and cosine floor — wire to an optimizer’s **lr schedule** socket.

label: Memorization A dataset
hint: Memory 1 dataset A: continuous x, random class labels (cross-entropy memorization). Pairs with memorization B.

label: Memorization B dataset
hint: Memory 1 dataset B: random input class + random output class (one-hot x); cross-entropy only, vs continuous-x dataset A.

label: MLP
hint: Configurable fully-connected network.

label: MNIST (official IDX, URL + cache)
hint: Official MNIST (28×28 grayscale): IDX download over HTTPS with local cache; 10-class labels.

label: Model Checkpoint
hint: Save or load model + optimizer state.

label: Model weight tensors
hint: Materialize all model parameters (named_parameters); wire tensor list into Tensor selector to pick one.

label: Modular addition dataset
hint: Grokking-style modular arithmetic: input tokens [a,b], label is (a + b) mod p.

label: MoE MLP
hint: Mixture-of-experts MLP: softmax gate mixes K expert MLPs.

label: MPP-style spatiotemporal ViT
hint: MPP-like ViT: patchify frames, Transformer over space-time tokens, unpatch; matches arXiv:2310.02994-style field normalization.

label: MSE Loss
hint: Mean squared error loss for regression.

label: Multi-hop fact chain synthetic LM
hint: Synthetic chained relational facts plus query segment; scales hops for multi-step retrieval pressure.

label: Muon
hint: Muon-style optimizer with momentum for deeper-model experiments.

label: MuP initialization
hint: μP-style weight init (Linear / Embedding / LayerNorm). Wire into a model’s initialization target before training.

label: MuP LR schedule
hint: μP Adam LR multipliers by parameter group (embed / hidden / output) — wire to the same **lr schedule** socket (Adam + supported models); combine with an lr_schedule node for warmup / cosine.

label: N-gram language dataset
hint: Random Markov order-n transitions (Dirichlet-smoothed rows); LM baseline.

label: Transformer (numerics)
hint: Transformer encoder on numeric tensors [batch, T, D_in] → [batch, T, D_out]; default causal self-attention (optional full-context / bidirectional).

label: Accuracy
hint: Classification accuracy (top-1) from trainer predictions versus target labels at each log step.

observable.infoMarkdown: **Accuracy** — classification accuracy on the train (and test when available) batch used for logging.

label: Activation norm (mean)
hint: Mean L2 norm of hooked Linear/Conv outputs; global pooled or per activation-stats bucket (multi-curve).

observable.infoMarkdown: **Activation norm (mean)** — mean L2 norm of Linear/Conv outputs (extra forward). **Global**: average over hooked modules. **All layers**: one curve per activation-stats bucket (`layers.0`, …, **other**), primary = mean of bucket means.

label: Activation outlier ratio
hint: max|act|/mean|act| in the same hook pass; global or per-bucket (multi-curve).

observable.infoMarkdown: **Activation outlier ratio** — max |activation| / mean |activation| in the same hook pass as norm mean. **Global**: pooled; **All layers**: one ratio per bucket, primary = mean of bucket ratios.

label: Activation mean/std
hint: Mean and std of Linear/Conv activations: global = equal average across layer buckets (.layers.0., …) vs other modules; or separate series per bucket.

observable.infoMarkdown: **Activation mean/std** — mean and standard deviation of activations at Linear/Conv outputs (extra forward). Hooks are grouped by encoder layer index in the module path (`layers.0`, `layers.1`, …) vs **other** modules. **Layers → Global** averages those bucket statistics equally; **All layers** logs separate mean/std series per bucket.

label: Attention entropy (mean)
hint: Mean entropy of attention rows; global = last layer, all layers = one curve per encoder layer (same cores as sink mass).

observable.infoMarkdown: **Attention entropy (mean)** — mean Shannon entropy over attention keys. **Global**: last encoder layer (legacy default). **All layers**: average over layers in the primary series plus one curve per layer. Same supported cores as sink mass.

label: Attention head sink max
hint: Max over heads of mean attention to sink key; global vs per-layer series like sink mass.

observable.infoMarkdown: **Attention head sink max** — max over heads of mean mass on the sink key. **Global** = last layer; **All layers** = per-layer curves + mean.

label: Attention map
hint: Records every selected layer, batch, and head tuple at each logging step (at most 20 slices). Retains the newest 50 frames; maps larger than 25 by 25 are stored as their final 25 by 25 window.

observable.infoMarkdown: **Attention map** — records the Cartesian product of selected layer, batch, and head indices at every logging step. At most **20 slices** are recorded per step, the newest **50 frames** are retained, and maps larger than **25 x 25** retain their final query/key window.

label: Attention max weight (mean)
hint: Mean max softmax mass per query; global = last layer or all layers = per-layer curves.

observable.infoMarkdown: **Attention max weight (mean)** — mean max softmax mass to any key. **Global** = last layer; **All layers** = per-layer curves + layer mean in the primary series.

label: Attention position bias ratio
hint: Early-key vs average-key mass ratio; global vs per-layer series.

observable.infoMarkdown: **Attention position bias ratio** — early-key vs average-key mass ratio. **Global** = last layer; **All layers** = per-layer curves + mean.

label: Attention relation score
hint: Scores selected full-map attention cells using safe query/key position and token predicates.

observable.infoMarkdown: **Attention relation score** — mean attention to keys selected by a restricted relation predicate.

label: Bezier mode connectivity
hint: Optimize a quadratic Bezier control point between two checkpoints, then compare its loss path to linear interpolation.

label: Capacity
hint: Memorization capacity in bits: (log(V) - loss) * N / log(2).

observable.infoMarkdown: **Capacity** — summary statistic related to effective model capacity on the logging batch (implementation-defined in the trainer).

label: Embedding effective rank
hint: Effective rank of the token embedding (global) or max rank per encoder block .layers.i (all layers, multi-curve).

observable.infoMarkdown: **Embedding effective rank** — **Global**: entropy-based effective rank of the token embedding matrix. **All layers**: max effective rank among 2D weights in each encoder block (`layers.i`), one curve per block.

label: Embedding evolution
hint: Relative embedding drift over training (||E_t-E_0|| / ||E_0||).

observable.infoMarkdown: **Embedding evolution** — relative drift \(\|E_t - E_0\| / \|E_0\|\) of the token embedding matrix across training steps.

label: Embedding feature drift
hint: 1 − cosine between successive embeddings (global) or between flattened weights per .layers.i (all layers).

observable.infoMarkdown: **Embedding feature drift** — **Global**: 1 − cosine between consecutive flattened embedding matrices. **All layers**: same metric on flattened weights concatenated per encoder block.

label: Embedding trajectory
hint: Logs per-token embedding vectors over training for trajectory plotting.

observable.infoMarkdown: **Embedding trajectory** — low-dimensional projection / path of embedding statistics over training (paired viz shows curves).

label: Fourier component
hint: Projects a regression target and prediction onto a sin/cos basis at one input frequency.

observable.infoMarkdown: **Fourier component** projects the logging-batch target and prediction onto a sin/cos basis. `relative_projection_mse` is normalized component error; `amplitude_ratio` is prediction amplitude divided by target amplitude.

label: Gradient norm
hint: Log L2 norm of gradients each step: global, per top-level name segment, or per-parameter tensor (capped). Optional normalization by √(parameter count).

observable.infoMarkdown: **Gradient norm** — L2 norm of parameter gradients after each logged step: **global**, **top-level module** (first name segment), or **per-parameter tensor** (one curve per parameter with gradients, capped). **Normalized** (default): divide by √(parameter count) in that scope.

label: Hessian eigenvalues
hint: Logs ranked Hessian eigenvalues of the training loss (second derivatives wrt parameters).

observable.infoMarkdown: **Hessian eigenvalues** — top-k eigenvalues of the loss Hessian (or surrogate) when the trainer can form them; limited to modest models.

label: Information plane
hint: Binned I(X;T) / I(T;Y) trajectories. maxSamples bounds deterministic evaluation sampling and CPU transfer per log point; Trainer log frequency controls how often this work runs.

observable.infoMarkdown: **Information plane** bins bounded activations and plots each layer at `I(X;T)` versus `I(T;Y)`. It samples at most `maxSamples` evaluation rows and synchronizes those activations to CPU at each Trainer log point; increase the Trainer log interval for lower overhead.

label: Last layer weight norm
hint: L2 norm of the last nn.Linear weight (classification layer); the Slingshot Effect signature signal.

observable.infoMarkdown: **Last layer weight norm** — ‖W‖₂ of the final `nn.Linear` (classification layer). During the Terminal Phase of Training with Adam-family optimizers this norm shows cyclic rapid-growth → curtailment phases; each transition coincides with a training loss spike (the Slingshot Effect, Thilak et al. 2024). NaN if the model has no Linear layer.

label: Layer spectral norm
hint: Logs one norm curve per Linear layer using a deterministic, RNG-neutral measurement.

observable.infoMarkdown: **Layer spectral norm** records every `Linear.weight` matrix without changing training RNG. `singular_value` is conventional power iteration on `W.T @ W`; `author_figure1` preserves the released Rahaman Figure 1 notebook estimator. Vector-shaped first/last layers use their exact vector norm; optional seeded Gaussian starts replay the notebook without touching training RNG.

label: Linear interpolation barrier
hint: Evaluate train/test loss and accuracy along theta(alpha) between two model checkpoints.

label: Neuron trajectory 2D
hint: Records first hidden-layer weight rows wᵢ∈ℝ² at each log step (2D neuron positions for rich/lazy regime).

observable.infoMarkdown: **Neuron trajectory 2D** — records first hidden-layer weight positions wᵢ∈ℝ² at each log step; visualize as scatter+trails to see feature learning (rich regime) vs frozen features (lazy regime), Chizat et al. 2019.

label: ReLU nonlinear count
hint: Count post-ReLU units that are on for some batch samples and off for others (per hidden layer).

observable.infoMarkdown: **ReLU nonlinear count** — counts hidden units that are on for some samples and off for others on the batch (a coarse “nonlinearity” signal).

label: Representation alphaReQ
hint: Power-law decay exponent of a selected representation covariance spectrum.

observable.infoMarkdown: **Representation alphaReQ** - fit `log(lambda_i) = c - alpha log(i)` to the positive centered-covariance eigenvalues. Larger alpha means more concentrated variance.

label: Representation RankMe
hint: Entropy effective rank of a selected representation's centered feature covariance.

observable.infoMarkdown: **Representation RankMe** — flatten the selected activation to samples × features, center each feature, form `Σ = FᵀF / M`, and report the exponential entropy of its normalized eigenvalues. The two largest covariance eigenvalues are also logged.

label: Sink attention mass
hint: Mean softmax attention to a chosen key index (sink); global = averaged over encoder layers, or one series per layer. Attention-only + transformer / numeric token paths.

observable.infoMarkdown: **Sink attention mass** — mass on a chosen key index (often BOS / first token) in softmax self-attention; high values indicate attention sink behavior. **Layers → Global** averages mean sink mass over all encoder layers; **All layers** records one value per layer (multi-curve viz). Models: **attention_only_model** (one layer), **transformer_token_model**, **transformer_multi_token_model**, **numeric_transformer_model**.

label: Train vs test gap
hint: Logs test loss minus train loss when a train/test split exists.

observable.infoMarkdown: **Train vs test gap** — test loss minus train loss at each logged step when a train/test split exists.

label: User observable
hint: User-defined scalar from tensor path (saved definitions).

observable.infoMarkdown: **User observable** — runs your registered training-eval code over a tensor path from the graph; the scalar returned is logged each step when wired to the Trainer.

label: Observable viz
hint: Mirror for an observable wired to the trainer (auto-spawns when you connect observable → trainer).

observable.infoMarkdown: **Observable viz** — mirror node that plots streamed histories from a paired trainer observable. Wire Trainer → observable source, pair this viz to that source, then Train.

label: Weight displacement (‖Δw‖/‖w₀‖)
hint: Fractional parameter displacement ‖w(t)−w(0)‖_F / ‖w(0)‖_F from the first log snapshot.

observable.infoMarkdown: **Weight displacement** — ‖w(t)−w(0)‖_F / ‖w(0)‖_F over all parameters from the first log snapshot. Small in the lazy/NTK regime, large under feature learning.

label: Weight L1
hint: Log L1 norm of weights during training.

observable.infoMarkdown: **Weight L1** — sum of absolute values of weights each log step. Complements L2 for sparsity / scale diagnostics.

label: Weight L2
hint: Log L2 norm of weights each step: global, per top-level name segment, or per-parameter tensor (capped).

observable.infoMarkdown: **Weight L2** — Euclidean norm of weights each log step: **global** (entire model), **top-level module** (first segment of each parameter name), or **per-parameter tensor** (one curve per weight tensor, capped).

label: Weight product SV
hint: Logs top-k singular values of the effective weight product W_eff = W_n … W_1 at each log step.

observable.infoMarkdown: **Weight product SV** — top-k singular values of the effective weight product W_eff = W_n ⋯ W_1 (all .weight tensors multiplied right-to-left). Use with deep linear networks to observe staggered singular-value learning (Saxe et al. 2013).

label: Paper classification dataset
hint: Dense toy tasks for Rank Collapse (fixed Figure-5 samples, scalable X=I_N orthogonal CE/MSE protocols, plus legacy repeated-prototype controls) and Slingshot (8-class noisy hypercube); no Grokking task is used.

label: Parametric path sampler
hint: Linear path w(α)=w_SB+α(w_LB−w_SB); eval loss/accuracy vs α.

label: PCA
hint: Principal component analysis on tensor batches.

label: PCFG toy LM dataset
hint: PCFG toy LM: binary-tree legacy mode or cfg_sentence (weighted rules + lexicon) → padded next-token windows.

label: phi-1 style corpus dataset
hint: phi-1–style mixed textbook/QA/code toy corpus LM (synthetic / optional URL).

label: Random input distribution
hint: Random x generator settings (base law + optional Gaussian jitter) for a teacher dataset.

label: Rank-aligned initialization
hint: Balanced two-factor initialization. With orthogonal Figure-5 samples S=I it gives the paper condition F^T F = W W^T; on legacy repeated-sample datasets it only gives factor-Gram alignment. The frequency-structured basis is the verified N=60, C=4, d in {2, 3} geometric-frequency protocol. robust_v1 locks the searched input rotation angle/plane to 3.0/1 and output rotation angle/plane to 1.7/2. Both Linear biases are pinned to zero.

label: Reaction–diffusion field (Fisher–KPP)
hint: Fisher–KPP reaction–diffusion on a periodic grid; paired targets one Euler step ahead.

label: Regressor
hint: Regressor node for analysis workflows.

label: Relation tuple synthetic LM
hint: Synthetic relation triple or inverse-query sequences; next-token CE without real KG text.

label: Reshape
hint: Einops-style reshape rule string on the tensor chain (documentation / subgraph layout).

fields.label: Reshape Rule
fields.defaultValue: b t d -> b t d

label: Residual LN model
hint: Composable residual model with Pre-LN/Post-LN mode and alpha-scaled FC2 blocks.

label: ResNet (vision)
hint: Small ResNet-style CNN for 1×H×W inputs; use with vision datasets + cross-entropy.

label: RMSNorm layer
hint: LLaMA-style RMS normalization on the last tensor dimension (optional affine scale).

label: Rotary positional embedding
hint: RoPE on the last (even) feature dimension along positions on axis -2; shape-preserving in the chain.

label: RWKV-lite (tokens)
hint: Gated time recurrence + gated FF (RWKV-flavored); token LM.

label: SCAN toy dataset
hint: SCAN-like command→action toy data; synthetic offline or optional tasks.txt download.

label: Series endpoint gap
hint: Scalar last−first gap for a rank-1 (1D) upstream tensor (endpoint change of the series).

label: SGD
hint: Stochastic gradient descent optimizer with momentum.

label: Shampoo
hint: Shampoo matrix-preconditioned optimizer.

label: Shape checker
hint: Attach to a node output and click Check shape to show the current tensor shape.

label: Shape world (square / triangle / circle)
hint: 3-class synthetic geometry: square vs triangle vs circle on gray noise.

label: SignSGD
hint: SignSGD optimizer that steps by gradient sign.

label: Slot attention (tokens)
hint: Slot attention over embeddings; pooled slots → logits (token LM).

label: Small Inception (CIFAR)
hint: Small Inception used in Zhang et al.'s CIFAR experiments. It accepts the default 32×32 CIFAR inputs; use the CIFAR paper whitening preprocessing to match the paper's 28×28 protocol. 1,649,402 trainable parameters for 10 classes.

label: Smoothing curve
hint: Apply Gaussian smoothing on a rank-1 (1D) tensor, preview the smoothed curve, and pass it downstream as tensor.

label: SOAP
hint: SOAP optimizer: Adam moments in Shampoo eigenspaces.

label: Softmax
hint: Softmax along a configurable dimension in the tensor chain.

label: Statistics
hint: Einstein / einsum subscripts on one tensor; choose mean, max, … for collapsed axes.

label: Statistics 2 (pair)
hint: Two tensors: NumPy-style einsum pair; dot or cosine over contracted indices.

label: SVD
hint: Full singular value decomposition (U, S, Vh); optional column mean removal.

label: Sweep data table
hint: Accumulate sweep runs in a table from a 0D tensor viz stream.

label: Symbolic func dataset
hint: LaTeX y(x) + numeric params → sampled (x, y) for the trainer (SymPy on server).

label: Synthetic playground LM (Depo/Brevo/…)
hint: Preset synthetic streams (depo/brevo/mano/capo/lano-style axes) for controlled LM experiments.

label: Table viz
hint: Line plot from a sweep data table (x-axis and legend here).

label: Teacher dataset
hint: Regression pairs y = f_teacher(x): wire an MLP teacher + train/test sample tensors from input sampler nodes.

label: Tensor add
hint: Two tensors: element-wise sum with NumPy-style broadcasting.

label: Tensor concat
hint: Concatenate multiple tensors into one output tensor (configurable number of inputs).

label: Tensor constant
hint: Configurable dense tensor (zeros, uniform [-1,1], or Gaussian); init seed for random fills; view values in parameters.

label: Tensor linspace
hint: Creates a 1D tensor with evenly spaced points between start and end, either linearly or in log10 space.

label: Tensor reader
hint: Connect a tensor and open View tensor values for nested JSON (read-only), like model parameters.

label: Tensor selector
hint: Pick which tensor from upstream (activations, model weights, losses, …) to visualize or aggregate.

label: Tensor slicing
hint: Slice one tensor dimension by selected indices. One index collapses that dimension; multiple keep it with new size.

label: Tensor stack
hint: Stack multiple tensors into one output tensor (configurable number of inputs).

label: 0D tensor viz
hint: Scalar / 0D tensor panel.

label: 1D tensor viz
hint: 1D tensor / series visualization.

label: 2D tensor viz
hint: 2D tensor / heatmap visualization.

label: General tensor viz
hint: General-purpose tensor visualization.

label: Scatter plot viz
hint: Scatter plot of tensor 1 vs tensor 2 (both effectively 1D).

label: TinyShakespeare language-model dataset
hint: Real TinyShakespeare word-level next-token corpus. Download is required; this node never substitutes synthetic text.

label: TinyStories-style corpus dataset
hint: TinyStories-style sliding-window LM; synthetic prose or optional small text URL.

label: Token Retrieval (position/content) dataset
hint: Random token sequences; choose retrieval by fixed position index or by nearest prior content to the last token.

label: Trainer
hint: Training loop: datasets, model, optimizer, loss, and observables.

label: Training visualization
hint: Plots loss curves during and after training.

label: Transformer (multiple tokens)
hint: K token ids per timestep [batch, L, K], fused per position, TransformerEncoder → last-timestep logits [batch, K, V]. For circular motion use K = 2.

label: Transformer (tokens)
hint: Embedding + TransformerEncoder + lm_head on token ids [batch, T] → last-position logits [batch, V]; optional tied embedding / lm_head weights (GPT-style).

label: Unembedding layer
hint: LM-head style torch.nn.Linear(d_model → vocab); pair after blocks that emit hidden activations.

label: UNet DDPM
